channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: Trump names national intelligence chief Jay Clayton as new AI czar
item.description: Trump said Clayton will lead the White House's new "Super Intelligence Force," which will coordinate government engagement with artificial intelligence.

item.title: U.S. Marine arrested for alleged murder of a woman in Okinawa, Japan
item.description: Japanese police arrested a U.S. Marine in the alleged robbery and murder of a woman on Okinawa, officials said Sunday.

item.title: Latter-day Saints women turn away from scandal-plagued Republican candidate in Arizona
item.description: Arizona Republican candidate for Congress Mark Lamb has been accused of sexual misconduct while sheriff. His controversy is turning many voters away as Democrats see an opportunity in the red seat.

item.title: Shark bites fisherman twice during kayaking encounter along California beach
item.description: A Malibu shark encounter sent a kayaker to the hospital after he reportedly reeled in a suspected mako shark while fishing off the California coast.

item.title: Mass shooting at Georgia block party leaves 2 dead, 35 injured
item.description: A mass shooting at a block party in South Georgia left two people dead and more than three dozen others wounded early Sunday morning, according to officials.

item.title: Tyreek Hill fuels Chiefs reunion speculation with cryptic post as old team loses two receivers to injury
item.description: Tyreek Hill posted a cryptic tweet after the Kansas City Chiefs lost Rashee Rice and Tyquan Thronton to injuries in their Week 4 win over the Raiders.

item.title: Singer Phil Collins blasts Trump as 'nasty,' teases song about America called 'Fat People with Guns'
item.description: Phil Collins revealed an unwritten song called "Fat People With Guns" about America and slammed Trump's demeanor in a "Piers Morgan Uncensored" interview.

item.title: US pulls all bombers from key UK base after suspected Iran-linked terror plot
item.description: The Pentagon says its bomber force remains ready for global strikes after aircraft deployed to RAF Fairford returned to the United States.

item.title: Bolsonaro wins first round of Brazilian presidential election, as Trump-backed candidates continue red wave
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro won the first round of Brazil's presidential election, and will now face off against incumbent Lula da Silva in a second round on October 25.

item.title: As Trump rallies his base in Ohio, a Haitian migrant is laid to rest nearby
item.description: Mourners in Springfield, Ohio, blamed Pierre Damas Bel’s death on President Donald Trump’s deportation campaign. Trump’s supporters said ICE needs to do more.

item.title: Should Big Oil pay for climate change? A Supreme Court case will help decide.
item.description: Boulder, Colorado, is hoping its novel lawsuit will be the environmental equivalent of the landmark litigation that produced billions in damages and settlements against Big Tobacco and opioid makers.

item.title: ‘Dying on the vine’: How a farmer ended up with 1,600 tons of unwanted grapes
item.description: Falling demand for juice has left Lake Erie grape growers with fruit they can’t sell.

item.title: With threats to midterms, states say Trump administration isn’t helping
item.description: U.S. spy agencies see Russia and others plotting to sow distrust and misinformation in the upcoming elections.

item.title: Trump launches ‘Super Intelligence Force’ after calls for AI slowdown
item.description: Leaders from the intelligence community, the Pentagon, the Federal Trade Commission and the Office of Personnel Management will serve on the task force.

item.title: Trump’s opponents are planning efforts to reverse his changes to presidency
item.description: As the midterms approach, some of the president’s foes are working to ensure his aggressive approach to executive power doesn’t outlast him.

item.title: Should Big Oil pay for climate change? A Supreme Court case will help decide.
item.description: Boulder, Colorado, is hoping its novel lawsuit will be the environmental equivalent of the landmark litigation that produced billions in damages and settlements against Big Tobacco and opioid makers.

item.title: An election chief lost. Then he padlocked the ballots and called the FBI.
item.description: Shasta County, California, where election doubts run so deep that some don’t trust results even when their choice prevails, offers a glimpse of what happens when distrust in voting systems takes root.

item.title: How Roy Cooper became Democrats’ best chance to flip a Senate seat
item.description: The former North Carolina governor is running in a state that for decades has more often preferred Republicans for federal office.

item.title: Trump announces plan to send $90 payments to millions of seniors
item.description: The White House said the one-time payments would be drawn from a fund set up to improve Medicare.

item.title: Trump reveals Tom Cotton’s phone number in daylight saving time standoff
item.description: The GOP senator, usually a staunch Trump ally, has vowed to oppose efforts for year-round daylight saving time. He reiterated his opposition Saturday.
